scripts.dev:backend: pnpm build:static && uv run --env-file python.env python backend/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8100
scripts.build:static: uv run --env-file python.env python backend/manage.py collectstatic --noinput
scripts.build: pnpm build:static && pnpm --filter @app-base/frontend build && pnpm --filter @app-base/native build
scripts.build:python: uv run --env-file python.env --group build pyinstaller backend/backend.spec --noconfirm --distpath backend/dist --workpath backend/build
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm build:python && pnpm --filter @app-base/native package:mac
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --env-file python.env ruff format backend mcp && uv run --env-file python.env ruff check --fix backend mcp
scripts.schema:generate: uv run --env-file python.env python backend/manage.py spectacular --file .cache/openapi.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.check:python: uv run --env-file python.env ruff check backend mcp && uv run --env-file python.env ruff format --check backend mcp && pnpm typecheck:backend && pnpm typecheck:mcp && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:mcp && uv run --env-file python.env python backend/manage.py check && pnpm schema:generate
scripts.check: pnpm api:check && pnpm check:unused && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:python && pnpm build
scripts.setup:admin: uv run --env-file python.env --env-file .env.local python backend/manage.py createsuperuser --noinput
scripts.test:backend: uv run --env-file python.env pytest -c backend/pytest.ini -q --tb=short backend/tests
scripts.test:mcp: uv run --env-file python.env pytest -c mcp/pytest.ini -q --tb=short mcp/tests
scripts.audit:python: uv export --locked --all-groups --no-emit-project --format requirements-txt --output-file .cache/audit/requirements.txt --quiet && uv run --locked --env-file python.env pip-audit --require-hashes --requirement .cache/audit/requirements.txt --cache-dir .cache/pip-audit --progress-spinner off
